d: We are currently seeking for passionate and dynamic Maintenance professionals who pride themselves on their ability to deliver extraordinary levels of customer service and provide creative solutions to our guests. As an Electrician you are responsible to install/ maintain and repair electrical wiring/ equipment and fixtures to ensure that work is in accordance with relevant codes and your role will include key responsibilities such as bull; Maintenance of all M E and HVAC equipment within the hotel complex with special emphasis on health safety bull; Maintenance and repair works of all mechanical and electrical heating and ventilation equipment/ ensuring the on-going safe and efficient running of the hotel bull; Fix mains domestic single and 3 phase supplied distribution systems and all lighting and in house power installations appliances bull; Assist with all emergency services/ e.g. fire alarms/ lighting/ batteries and standby power requirements/ inclusive of generators bull; Control systems to M E related processes e.g. general equipment/ televisions/ hair dryers/ shavers sockets/ etc. and all guest and service lifts bull; Prepare sketches or follow blueprints to determine the location of wiring and equipment and ensure conformance to building and safety codes bull; Use a variety of tools and equipment such as power construction equipment/ measuring devices/ power tools and testing equipment including oscilloscopes/ ammeters and test lamps.

You should have a proven knowledge in the operation and electrical maintenance of the equipment. A good command of English and the ability to find fault and rectify systems are essentials. Knowledge Competencies The ideal candidate will be self-motivated with a hands on and flexible approach and be able to adapt to unpredictable events. d: HR Specialist / Talent Acquisition SpecialistRole Description

We are seeking organized, people-oriented, and strategic professionals to support human resource management, talent acquisition, employee engagement, and organizational development. The successful candidates will contribute to strengthening workforce capabilities, improving recruitment processes, supporting employee relations, and implementing effective HR practices while ensuring alignment with organizational policies and business objectives.

Responsible for supporting and coordinating human resource functions, including employee administration, workforce planning, performance management, employee engagement, and HR policy implementation. Duties include maintaining employee records, coordinating onboarding and offboarding activities, supporting payroll and benefits administration, assisting with performance evaluations, handling employee inquiries, and ensuring compliance with internal HR procedures and applicable employment regulations. The role also involves preparing HR reports, coordinating training and development initiatives, supporting employee relations activities, and collaborating with management to improve workforce efficiency and organizational effectiveness.

Responsible for managing recruitment activities and identifying qualified candidates to meet organizational workforce requirements. Duties include developing recruitment strategies, preparing job advertisements, sourcing candidates through professional networks and recruitment platforms, reviewing applications, conducting initial candidate screenings, coordinating interviews, and managing communication throughout the hiring process. The role also involves maintaining candidate databases, building talent pipelines, evaluating recruitment performance, supporting employer branding initiatives, and collaborating with hiring managers to ensure effective talent selection and recruitment outcomes.
Degree or relevant academic background in Human Resource Management, Business Administration, Organizational Psychology, or a related discipline.
Strong understanding of HR administration, recruitment procedures, talent management, and employee relations.
Familiarity with applicant tracking systems (ATS), HR management systems (HRMS), and recruitment platforms.
Knowledge of candidate sourcing, interview coordination, onboarding procedures, and workforce planning.
Ability to maintain confidential employee information and handle HR documentation accurately.
Excellent communication, interpersonal, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Strong ability to coordinate with candidates, employees, hiring managers, and external recruitment partners.
Commitment to professional HR practices, talent development, organizational effectiveness, and continuous improvement.
